title: Modern Nashville Home • Rooftop & Hot Tub
description:
Kick back in style at this brand-new 4-bedroom Nashville retreat, built for groups with open living spaces, modern finishes, and room for everyone to gather. Catch the skyline from the rooftop, then sink into the private hot tub after a full day out in Music City.

The space
Tucked on the north side of Nashville, about 20 minutes from the airport, you're always close to the action. Grab an Uber, Lyft, or scooter and you're minutes from Broadway's honky-tonks, live music, dining, and nightlife.

Book your stay and see for yourself why Nashville is one of the most in-demand destinations in the country — full of music, energy, and experiences you won't find anywhere else.

HOME LAYOUT:
• 4 Floor Unit
• Open-concept kitchen, living, and dining area
• Bedroom 1: 2 full beds with private bathroom
• Bedroom 2: Queen over queen bunk bed with private bathroom
• Bedroom 3: 2 full beds with private bathroom
• Bedroom 4: 2 Queen over queen bunk beds with private bathroom
• Rooftop

About Us:
At King Rentals, we’re committed to making your stay as comfortable, easy, and enjoyable as possible. As a locally owned and operated business, our friendly team is available 24/7 to help with any questions or needs during your stay. We’re here to help you relax, enjoy your time together, and create wonderful memories with your family and friends.

Key Features:
• Private rooftop hot tub
• Fully stocked kitchen
• Spacious living and kitchen area
• Washer and dryer
• Smart TVs and Wi-Fi
• 2-car garage parking
• Large rooftop patio with stunning city skyline views
• Some amenities, such as a Pack 'n Play, are available upon request. Please let us know in advance if you need them!

Location:
Here are some nearby places of interest:
• Lower Broadway - Nashville's "Strip" - All the famous Honky Tonks are here
• Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
• Luke's 32 Bridge - Luke Bryan's Bar
• Ole Red - Blake Shelton's Bar
• Casa Rosa - Miranda Lambert's Bar

Guest access
Guest access:
• Access codes will be provided for self-check-in
• Our home spans 4 levels, so stairs are needed to reach each floor
• There is an electronic lock on the door for a smooth, keyless entry
• The elevator(s) are non-operational for liability purposes

Other things to note
IMPORTANT – PLEASE READ BEFORE BOOKING:
• Maximum Occupancy: Maximum of 12 guests, including adults, children, and infants. No additional guests are permitted due to fire safety and insurance requirements.
• Age Requirement: All guests must be 18 or older, except children staying with their parents or guardians.
• No Parties: Parties and unauthorized gatherings are strictly prohibited. Noise complaints or law enforcement calls may result in immediate termination of the stay without a refund.
• No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited.
• No Pets: This property has a strict no-pet policy.
• Check-In/Check-Out: Check-in is at 3:00 PM and check-out is at 10:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out may be available for an additional fee starting at $60. Please message us in advance to check availability.
• Cancellations & Travel Insurance: We highly recommend purchasing travel insurance for protection against unexpected cancellations, weather, natural disasters, power outages, and other unforeseen events. We’re unable to offer refunds or rescheduled stays outside Airbnb’s Extenuating Circumstances Policy.
• Starter Supplies: We provide a starter supply of essential items. Please bring your personal toiletries and plan to purchase additional supplies if needed.
• Trash: Please place all trash in trash bags and place them in the trash can outside by garage.
• Stay Connected: Follow us at @kingrentalspropertymgmt for updates.
